[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec all_prefixes (s: String) : List String :=
  match s with
  | "" => []
  | _ :: t =>
    let prefix := s.get_prefix 1
    prefix :: all_prefixes t
all_prefixes string
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma string_take_prefix
(s: String)
(i: Nat)
: s.take (i + 1) = s.get_prefix (i + 1) :=
by
rw [String.take, String.get_prefix]
induction i
  case zero
  simp
  case succ
  simp [String.get_prefix]
  rw [String.take, String.get_prefix]
  simp [ih]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_length: result.length = string.length := by
  induction string
  simp [String.empty, all_prefixes]
  simp [String.cons, all_prefixes]
  rw [String.take, String.get_prefix]
  simp [ih]
  simp [String.get_prefix]
have h_spec: ∀ i, i < result.length → result[i]! = string.take (i + 1) := by
  induction string generalizing i
  simp [String.empty, all_prefixes]
  intros i h_i_lt
  have h_i_eq_0: i = 0 := by
    linarith
  simp [h_i_eq_0]
  simp [String.take, String.get_prefix]
  simp [String.get_prefix]
  simp [String.empty, all_prefixes]
  intros i h_i_lt
  simp [String.cons, all_prefixes]
  simp [String.take, String.get_prefix]
  simp [String.get_prefix]
  simp [String.take, String.get_prefix]
  rw [String.take, String.get_prefix]
  simp [ih]
  simp [String.get_prefix]
  have h_i_lt': i + 1 < string.length + 1 := by
    linarith
  simp [h_i_lt']
  simp [String.take, String.get_prefix]
  simp [String.get_prefix]
